dct_description_sm:
Moored instrument time series data include current velocity, temperature, salinity, oxygen, fluorescence, transmissivity, turbidity, and particle capture of carbon, nitrogen, and silicon.  Also included are sediment trap, ice drift and ice draft data.

These data were collected by researchers from the Institute of Ocean Sciences, Sidney, BC, from locations ranging from the Beaufort Sea, and across the Canadian Arctic Archipelago to Baffin Bay.

The data links below are only a representative sample of the entire collection.  If you require more data, please send your request to the data contact.
dct_title_s: Institute of Ocean Sciences Moored Instrument Data (Arctic), 1974-present
